<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844" width="390" height="844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F2EB"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F2EB"/>

  <!-- Status Bar -->

    <text x="18" y="29" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#0A0A0A">9:41</text>
    <g transform="translate(316,18)">
      <rect x="0" y="7" width="3" height="8" rx="1" fill="#0A0A0A"/>

  <!-- Chat background details -->
  <g opacity="0.26">
    <circle cx="72" cy="88" r="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="320" cy="140" r="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="298" cy="348" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="54" cy="468" r="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <circle cx="84" cy="726" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <rect x="314" y="270" width="28" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="40" y="600" width="42" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="54" width="390" height="80" fill="#F5F2EB"/>
    <circle cx="36" cy="94" r="20" fill="#D0D8CE"/>
    <text x="36" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">S</text>
    <text x="64" y="89" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18.3" font-weight="600" fill="#0A0A0A">Sofia Martinez</text>
    <text x="64" y="107" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#767779">last seen today at 9:32</text>
    <circle cx="306" cy="93" r="14" fill="#0A0A0A08"/>
    <circle cx="306" cy="93" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#0A0A0A" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="306" y1="88" x2="306" y2="98" stroke="#0A0A0A" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="301" y1="93" x2="311" y2="93" stroke="#0A0A0A" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="338" cy="93" r="14" fill="#0A0A0A08"/>

  <!-- Date chip -->
  <g>
    <rect x="141" y="145" width="108" height="26" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFFCC" stroke="#00000014"/>
    <text x="195" y="162" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#767779">Today • 8:12 AM</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Incoming and outgoing message bubbles -->
  <!-- Incoming 1 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="186" width="220" height="56" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0000000F"/>
    <text x="34" y="207" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">Morning! I reviewed the deck.</text>
    <text x="34" y="228" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">The new pricing slide looks sharp.</text>
    <text x="192" y="228" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#767779">8:13</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Outgoing 1 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="146" y="253" width="226" height="58" rx="18" fill="#D9F8D6"/>
    <text x="162" y="275" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">Great — I tightened the copy and</text>
    <text x="162" y="296" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">added the updated totals.</text>
    <text x="311" y="296" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#2F5B39">8:14</text>
    <polyline points="320,292 324,296 331,289" fill="none" stroke="#2F5B39" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <polyline points="324,292 328,296 335,289" fill="none" stroke="#2F5B39" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Incoming 2 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="326" width="192" height="72" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0000000F"/>
    <text x="34" y="347" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">Can you send the final PDF by</text>
    <text x="34" y="368" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">10:00? The team is waiting on it.</text>
    <text x="34" y="388" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#767779">8:15</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Reaction bubble -->
  <g>
    <rect x="226" y="375" width="42" height="24" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#F0E9DF"/>
    <text x="247" y="391" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">👍</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Outgoing 2 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="108" y="415" width="264" height="72" rx="18" fill="#D9F8D6"/>
    <text x="124" y="436" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">Absolutely. I’m exporting the final</text>
    <text x="124" y="457" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">version now and will drop it in here.</text>
    <text x="309" y="478" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#2F5B39">8:16</text>
    <polyline points="318,474 322,478 329,471" fill="none" stroke="#2F5B39" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <polyline points="322,474 326,478 333,471" fill="none" stroke="#2F5B39" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Incoming 3 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="506" width="230" height="68" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0000000F"/>
    <text x="34" y="528" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">Perfect. Also, Emma wanted a</text>
    <text x="34" y="549" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">note on the dashboard numbers.</text>
    <text x="34" y="569" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#767779">8:18</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Outgoing 3 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="152" y="583" width="218" height="60" rx="18" fill="#D9F8D6"/>
    <text x="168" y="605" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">Yep — I’m adding a small footnote</text>
    <text x="168" y="626" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">with the source data right now.</text>
    <text x="293" y="626" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#2F5B39">8:19</text>
    <polyline points="302,622 306,626 313,619" fill="none" stroke="#2F5B39" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <polyline points="306,622 310,626 317,619" fill="none" stroke="#2F5B39" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Incoming 4 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="661" width="178" height="54" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0000000F"/>
    <text x="34" y="683" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">Thanks! You’re a lifesaver.</text>
    <text x="34" y="704" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#767779">8:21</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Sent status with read checks -->
  <g>
    <text x="280" y="711" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#767779">Read 8:21</text>
    <polyline points="246,704 250,708 257,701" fill="none" stroke="#1DAB61" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <polyline points="251,704 255,708 262,701" fill="none" stroke="#1DAB61" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Outgoing 4 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="134" y="724" width="236" height="68" rx="18" fill="#D9F8D6"/>
    <text x="150" y="746" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">Anytime. I’ll ping you again once</text>

    <text x="305" y="788" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#2F5B39">8:22</text>
    <polyline points="314,784 318,788 325,781" fill="none" stroke="#2F5B39" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <polyline points="318,784 322,788 329,781" fill="none" stroke="#2F5B39" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

    <rect x="0" y="780" width="390" height="64" fill="#F5F2EB"/>
    <rect x="12" y="792" width="34" height="34" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="29" cy="809" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#0A0A0A" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="25" y1="809" x2="33" y2="809" stroke="#0A0A0A" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="29" y1="805" x2="29" y2="813" stroke="#0A0A0A" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <rect x="54" y="791" width="252" height="36" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="69" y="813" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#767779">Reply to Sofia...</text>

    <rect x="314" y="791" width="34" height="34" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="331" cy="808" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#0A0A0A" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="326" y1="808" x2="336" y2="808" stroke="#0A0A0A" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="803" x2="331" y2="813" stroke="#0A0A0A" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <rect x="356" y="791" width="22" height="34" rx="11" fill="#1DAB61"/>
    <polygon points="362,808 369,804 369,812" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="362" y1="808" x2="369" y2="808" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom tab bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="780" width="390" height="64" fill="#F4F4F4CC" stroke="#0000004D"/>
    <g transform="translate(18,788)">
      <g transform="translate(10,2)">
        <rect x="7" y="4" width="10" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.4"/>

        <line x1="9" y1="13" x2="13" y2="13" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.4"/>
        <text x="12" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#767779">Calls</text>

        <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.5" fill="none" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.4"/>

        <text x="12" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#767779">Communities</text>
      </g>
      <g transform="translate(246,2)">
        <rect x="4" y="6" width="16" height="11" rx="3" fill="#0A0A0A"/>
        <line x1="8" y1="17" x2="8" y2="21" stroke="#0A0A0A" stroke-width="1.4"/>
        <line x1="16" y1="17" x2="16" y2="21" stroke="#0A0A0A" stroke-width="1.4"/>
        <text x="12" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#0A0A0A">Chats</text>
      </g>
      <g transform="translate(318,2)">
        <circle cx="12" cy="8" r="5.5" fill="none" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.4"/>
        <rect x="7" y="14" width="10" height="9" rx="4.5" fill="none" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.4"/>
        <text x="12" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#767779">Settings</text>
      </g>
    </g>
    <rect x="125" y="816" width="140" height="5" rx="100" fill="#0A0A0A"/>

  <!-- subtle dividers / overdraw to keep screen rich -->
  <line x1="18" y1="243" x2="372" y2="243" stroke="#00000008"/>
  <line x1="18" y1="314" x2="372" y2="314" stroke="#00000008"/>
  <line x1="18" y1="496" x2="372" y2="496" stroke="#00000008"/>
  <line x1="18" y1="651" x2="372" y2="651" stroke="#00000008"/>
  <line x1="18" y1="716" x2="372" y2="716" stroke="#00000008"/>
</svg>
